about.title: About
about.subtitle: A continuous learning
about.sci_p1: Luis Flor is a biologist specialized in grapevine physiology under drought conditions.
about.sci_p2: Since graduating from the University of the Balearic Islands, he has spent several years conducting research in the field of grapevine physiology under water-limited conditions. His work has focused on comparing the physiological responses of different genotypes, including emblematic Spanish varieties such as Tempranillo, and Garnacha, grafted onto well-known commercial rootstocks such as 110R and 140Ru, as well as newly developed hybrids.
about.sci_p3: He has published several scientific articles in high-impact journals, one of which was recognized as a Highly Cited Article. His research has significantly advanced the understanding of grapevine hydraulic system vulnerability under drought conditions.
about.tech_p1: Full-stack and Data analyst specializing in front-end and back-end web and app development.
about.tech_p2: Since graduating from 4Geeks Academy, I have refined my full-stack development and data analysis skills, creating dynamic and responsive applications using front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, CSS, HTML, and Next.js, as well as back-end frameworks like SQL, SQLite, and Flask. I combine my scientific background with analytical skills using RStudio for data analysis and visualization.
about.tech_p3: I have strong expertise in generative artificial intelligence, strategic integration of multiple AI systems to achieve optimal results, and process automation, applying these skills to enhance efficiency, productivity, and quality in programming, data analysis, and software development workflows.
